tui.profile_actions.available.assessment: The action means restore/undo this saved change, not deny consent or cancel an unrelated request. Label offers the action without claiming the action is already complete; actual authorization/enablement remains an engine concern.

tui.profile_actions.checking.assessment: An in-progress check, distinguishable from in-progress mutation; no completion guarantee.

tui.profile_actions.reverting.assessment: An in-progress restore/undo, not an already-completed result.

tui.profile_actions.check_status.assessment: A status inspection/check, not retry/reapply/revert; retains the technical shortcut placeholder. Suitable for lost-reply read-only reconciliation.

tui.profile_actions.reverted.assessment: Completed restore/undo, not merely available or requested. French/Hindi specify previous-version restoration, consistent with inverse context.

tui.profile_actions.unavailable.assessment: Restore action is not available/cannot be used; not a denial of the underlying requested profile change. Read together with unavailable_reason.

tui.profile_actions.stale.assessment: Profile changed; conveys stale state rather than completion. Compact ru/vi/ur/hi labels omit repeating Revert without losing profile-change meaning in receipt-control context.

tui.profile_actions.failed.assessment: Restore not completed/incomplete, leaving possible partial/unknown outcome; does not assert that nothing changed.

tui.profile_actions.unavailable_reason.assessment: Session cannot verify the action. Review the current profile before a new change request; no blind retry, unconditional backup command, or unauthorized-mutation advice.

tui.profile_actions.stale_reason.assessment: Profile changed after this save. Inspect current version; this action will not undo later changes. Negation and temporal scope retained.

tui.profile_actions.failed_reason.assessment: Could not complete restore; inspect the current profile before a new change request. No false no-change guarantee or automatic retry.
